request.description: Dry run: which published rule a lead matches and which CA it would be offered to now, without offering it or writing to the timeline. Only leads that are `new` or `qualified`, have consent status `ok` and no active offer are routed. The first matching published rule picks verified, active, unpaused CAs that may receive the lead (partner sharing consent for that CA, service area, capabilities, free capacity), skipping CAs that already declined, missed or returned this lead. Needs routing rule read access.
